title: The pool is closed on Wednesdays
scenario: Your friend Lena takes her six-year-old son swimming every Wednesday afternoon. Her English is basic. She sends you a photo of a notice at the pool and asks what it says. Explain it in simple words.

text: From Monday 3 March the pool will close for cleaning every Wednesday from 12:00 to 16:00.
On Saturdays the pool now opens one hour earlier, at 8:00.
Children under 8 must always be with an adult.
Lockers need a coin. Please bring your own.
The cafe is closed until further notice.

task.audience: a friend who is learning English
task.prompt: Write a short message to Lena (30–55 words). Use easy words and short sentences. Tell her only what matters for her Wednesday visits.

points.idea: The pool is closed on Wednesdays.
It is closed from 12 to 4 in the afternoon.
Her young son must be with an adult.

model: Hi Lena! From 3 March the pool is closed every Wednesday from 12 to 4 in the afternoon, so please don't go then. Your son is only six, so he must always be with an adult. Maybe try another day this week!
useful: He must be with an adult.
tips: A sign talks to everybody. Your friend needs only the lines that change HER plan, so ignore the rest.
Say the day and the hours together (Wednesday, 12 to 4) so she can check them against her own plans.
explain: A good answer gives the day, the hours and the start date, and links the adult rule to her son. The Saturday time, the lockers and the cafe do not change her Wednesday plan.
